summary: Peggy Karp proposes rules for forming ARPANET host names after feedback on her first list in RFC 226. Names would be eight characters, of the form site, dash, machine, with the site part built from the name or a standard acronym. It replaced RFC 226.

eli5.summary: A recipe for making a computer's nickname from its site and machine: a short site code, a dash, then a short machine code.

questions: host name rules site dash machine
